in_marathi.name: Apoorva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apoorva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Apoorva means new, fresh, and unparalleled. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'apoorva' which means 'unseen, unheard, unprecedented'. In Hindu mythology, Apoorva is a name given to the goddess of prosperity and good fortune, Lakshmi, who is believed to bring new beginnings and fresh opportunities.
